user.title: Set up Android Device Control
user.description: Found {device_count} Android Companion App device(s): {device_names}. {ready_count} currently have the registration and push metadata needed for command dispatch. No notify-service mapping is required. This integration creates actions, not normal control entities. After setup, choose Android Device Control actions in Automations or Scripts.

no_devices.title: No Android devices found
no_devices.description: Android Device Control adds actions, not normal control entities. No compatible registration was found yet. Install the official Home Assistant Companion App for Android, register it with this Home Assistant instance, and enable Mobile App push notifications. You can finish setup now; no manual device or notify-service mapping is required. After a device is registered, choose Android Device Control actions in Automations or Scripts.

find_phone.name: Find phone
find_phone.description: Start a bounded Find Phone session. The first audible attempt is immediate; repeats wait for the configured interval and stop at the maximum attempt count. For fastest unlock detection, register android.intent.action.USER_PRESENT under Companion Manage Sensors → Last Update Trigger → Intent, then force-stop and restart Companion. The keyguard sensor is used as a fallback when available, and Stop ringing remains available.
